name: Goblin Rest Camp
_design: Safe rest stop between fights (no monsters; Boss 2026-10-14: grown to 19.6 x 15 m, ~1.3x). A green clearing round a calm campfire with three logs to sit on, a lantern post, two canvas tents, a supply crate stack, a hide-drying rack and a firewood stack; fireflies, flowers and warm light. The rest point is the campfire (`campfire` + a rest point there). The two exit portals stand north as in the fight arenas, so every stage reads the same way: come in south, leave north. Built by tools/blender/build_goblin_stages.py (art and this file come from one layout; edit the script, not this file).
